activity_text: Antimicrobial, Antibacterial, Anti-Gram+, Anti-Gram-, Antiviral, Anti-HIV, Anti-cancer
comments_text:
Function:  Significantly inhibits the growth of Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, also anti-HIV activity may be due to the inhibition of virual adsorption to cells.
PTM: Contains two disulfide bonds 3-16; 7-12 and Arginine amide at R17.
cytotoxicity_text: [Ref.28429216]It possessed a cytotoxic effect on HL-60 cells (acutehuman promyelocytic leukemia cells) , K562 cells(myelogenous leukemia cells) , TSU cells (prostatecancer cells) .
hemolytic_activity_text: [Ref.29870123] 9.6% hemolytic activity at 8 μg/mL and 72.8% hemolytic activity at 512 μg/mL against human red blood cells.
